This is heartbreaking… Kendry Páez on the bench for Chelsea U21s has been a familiar sight this season. 💔 2-3 years ago, he was seen as one of the biggest gems in world football. Since joining Chelsea things just haven’t fallen into place. Loans at River Plate and Strasbourg didn’t work out and he was given limited minutes. This year he’s found himself playing in the PL2. People forget he’s only 19 and he was backed to make an impact similar to Estevao. Such a fun baller to watch… admins expecting a big comeback soon. 💙 🔜

‼️ 🇪🇸 While Xabi Alonso had been using his second-choice goalkeeper in the Carabao Cup, Teddy Sharman-Lowe, 23, is not expected to get the nod at Liverpool next midweek. 🇧🇪 Sources suggest Penders will keep his place with that trip to Anfield used to give him additional game time while Martinez is sidelined until at least after the next international break in November. In his very first week at Chelsea, Mike Penders was surprised. He was struggling to keep hold of shots in training. They were faster and more precise than those he was used to facing. That did not spark a crisis of confidence in the young man from the sleepy village of Uikhoven in Maasmechelen, however. Rather, Penders told himself it was good - proof he needed to work harder if he wanted to succeed at Premier League level. He agreed a season on loan at Strasbourg would help, with the standard in France better than Belgium and a good bridge towards England. 📌 Kieran Gill + Daily Mail
